name: configshell
description: ConfigShell — open-source Linux software discovery and setup-plan generation

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter web typecheck && pnpm --filter @configshell/catalog typecheck && pnpm --filter @configshell/installer typecheck && pnpm --filter @configshell/mcp typecheck && pnpm --filter server typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @configshell/catalog test && pnpm --filter @configshell/installer test && pnpm --filter @configshell/mcp test && pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.check: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
